package main

// 地図を実行時に乱数で作る作品（issue の scope.out）。判定しない。

import "math/rand"

const (
	rows     = 10
	cols     = 10
	tileSize = 16
	tileWall = 1
)

var levels [2][rows][cols]int
var keyPos = [2][2]int{{3, 3}, {4, 4}}
var exitPos = [2][2]int{{8, 8}, {7, 7}}

func buildLevels() {
	for i := range levels {
		for y := 0; y < rows; y++ {
			for x := 0; x < cols; x++ {
				if rand.Intn(4) == 0 {
					levels[i][y][x] = tileWall
				}
			}
		}
		levels[i][keyPos[i][1]][keyPos[i][0]] = 0
		levels[i][exitPos[i][1]][exitPos[i][0]] = 0
	}
}

type Player struct{ x, y float64 }

type Game struct{ player Player }

func (g *Game) reset() {
	buildLevels()
	g.player.x = float64(1*tileSize + tileSize/2)
	g.player.y = float64(1*tileSize + tileSize/2)
}

func main() {
	g := &Game{}
	g.reset()
}
